Internal whitelist/condition gate computing the Uniswap pair and checking owner/trade/whitelist addresses.
Payable public approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits against _onSaleNum[_from] and _value.
Owner-only function performing a low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary data.

Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist variable.
Internal pure Uniswap V2 pair address computation using init code hash.
External caller address used for authentication, allowances and owner assignment.
Low-level delegatecall to an attacker/owner supplied address and calldata, executing arbitrary code in this contract's storage context.
